entities.summary: Aaron Jarvis is a former Wales international rugby union player. A prop forward he had previously played for the Dragons, ASM Clermont Auvergne, Ospreys and Bath. He was an assistant coach for the Dallas Jackals in the Major League Rugby (MLR).
